title: scrophularia neomexicana
intro: Scrophularia neomexicana, commonly known as New Mexico figwort, is a perennial plant in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throats, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of S. neomexicana include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
